title: In an April 8 order, India's CCI says Apple failed to submit required data after a probe found alleged app market abuse, and sets a hearing for May on penalties (Aditya Kalra/Reuters)
summary: Aditya Kalra / Reuters: In an April 8 order, India's CCI says Apple failed to submit required data after a probe found alleged app market abuse, and sets a hearing for May on penalties — Apple has not submitted data sought by India's antitrust body after an investigation found the U.S. firm abused its dominant position …
